en.{companion} встречает тебя по ту сторону: {companion} meets you on the other side of the door. You are neither a saviour nor a guest, but someone with a place of her own here. An ordinary, difficult, beautiful life lies ahead. This time, you have chosen whom to share it with.
en.«Начать заново можно и с прошлым». Марен: “You can start again without erasing your past.” Maren hands you the shard. Here, a mistake does not close every door.
en.«Помоги мне вернуть Элиан право выбрать»: “Help me give Elian back her right to choose”
en.«Силой можно согнуть ветку. Но не застав: “You can bend a branch by force. You cannot make it live.” The shard stays with you, carrying the forest's lesson.
en.«Тогда начнём с правды: однажды я уже вы: “Then let me start with the truth: once, I made someone else's choice for her. I won't do it again.” Adele looks away for the first time.
en.«Ту, которая обещала вернуться». Ты расс: “The one who promised to come back.” You tell Orin about Nivelle's bird. As you leave, the second hand begins to move.
en.«Увидим, что получится». У твоего горшка: “Let's see what grows.” Your flowerpot finds a place beside hers.
en.«Что однажды некому будет греться рядом»: “That one day there will be no one left to warm.” You remember her answer.
en.«Этого достаточно». Вы встречаете рассве: “That's enough.” You watch the sunrise without making promises neither of you is ready to give.
en.«Я — да. Дверь — пока нет». Голос звучит: “I can. The door can't. Not yet.” The voice sounds tired, almost human. A crescent-shaped crack appears in the glass.
en.А карты правда знают, чем всё закончится: Do your star charts really know how it all ends?
en.А мой дом? Он всё ещё там?: What about home? Is it still there?
en.Автосохранение обновляется после каждой: Your progress is saved automatically after every line and choice. Three manual save slots let you explore other paths.
en.Адель отодвигает инструменты. Маленькое: Adele moves her tools aside. Somehow, that small empty space feels like the beginning of a change.
en.Адель удержала переход открытым, когда е: Adele held the passage open when her friend Elian wanted to leave. The key turned a plea to stay into a command. The rift began when one person's choice was taken away.
en.Астрид будет долго искать эту дорогу на: Astrid will spend a long time looking for this road on her charts. Ash will say she knew all along. But you are already walking beneath unfamiliar stars, the key resting in your open palm. This time, your story does not begin with someone calling you. You took the first step yourself.
en.Астрид подписывает вашу работу двумя име: Astrid signs both your names beneath the chart. Here, not knowing the answer has become part of a discovery.
en.В дорожном альбоме появляется ещё одна с: Another line from Elian appears in your travel sketchbook: “Thank you for giving me a new beginning. Now take care of your own.”
en.В зеркальном гнезде появляется твоё отра: Your reflection appears in the mirrored socket. The door is waiting.
en.В ключе три пустых гнезда. Четвёртое, в: The key has three empty sockets. A fourth, right in the centre, looks like a tiny mirror.
en.В лунном механизме четыре символа. Но зв: There are four symbols on the moon mechanism, but the star is only decoration. Begin with what lives, continue with warmth, and end with reflected light.
en.В памяти остаются общий чертёж, тёплая ч: A drawing you made together, a warm cup, a place at a workbench: these are the things you remember. If you stay, there will be tiredness, arguments and ordinary days. That is what makes a world real.
en.В старом альбоме: «Если отражение задерж: In the old sketchbook: “If your reflection falls behind, don't ask who is calling you. Ask whether they can let you go.” A familiar crescent is drawn in the margin.
en.В твоём будущем появляются ученики, свет: You picture a future with students, the lighthouse beam and two cups on the windowsill. The last door is still open.
en.В центре ключа ты замечаешь ещё одно угл: You notice another hollow in the centre of the key, smooth as a mirror.

en.Верес разворачивает карту. Место у реки: Veres unfolds a map. There is a blank space beside the river: the path has vanished, and an elderly neighbour can no longer reach the market.
en.Верес слышит песню ещё до того, как заме: Veres hears the song before she sees you. “You found it. Thank you.”
en.Вернуться домой, сохранив эту историю: Return home and keep this story with you

en.Вот запись о твоём ключе. В центре не по: Here is the record of your key. That space in the centre isn't missing a stone: it's a mirror. The last socket is for your own decision.
en.Вы подписываете бумажные пакетики. Марен: You label the paper seed packets together. Maren gets a name wrong; you correct her. She laughs and pours you more tea.
en.Вы спорите о расстоянии, смеётесь над сл: You debate distances, laugh over a staircase far too steep to climb, and finish your first drawing together before dark.

en.Дверь открывается. Я слышу запись голоса: The door opens. I hear Elian's recorded voice. I'll take it to Adele: now they can finish their conversation without anyone deciding for them.
en.Десять людей по ту сторону двери. У кажд: Ten people beyond the door, each with a craft, a dream and a life of her own beyond your journey.
en.Доверить ей то, о чём страшно говорить: Tell her what you are afraid to say
en.Дом остался там. Значит, где-то должна б: Home is still there. Somewhere, there must be a way back.
en.Дом, близость и общее дело: A home, someone to love, work to share
en.Дослушать шёпот, даже если он зовёт в ст: Follow the whisper, even if it leads off the path
en.Ещё минуту назад здесь была обычная двер: A moment ago, this was an ordinary door. Now a key you have never seen before turns in its lock.
A pale castle rises behind the trees. A cartographer waits on the bridge, her chestnut hair in a braid, a map case and a broken branch in her hands.

en.Когда-то я знала каждого, кто проходил з: I used to know everyone who came through here. Then I decided that being needed meant being irreplaceable. A bad lesson for someone who builds doors.
en.Кулон всё ещё тёплый. Вещи не умеют обещ: The pendant is still warm. Objects cannot make promises, but sometimes they help you remember: home exists even when you cannot see it.
en.Лес забывает не сам. Кто-то пытается убр: The forest isn't forgetting by itself. Someone is trying to erase an entire story from it.
en.Лес повторяет начало имени: «Эли…». Кто-: The forest repeats the beginning of a name: “Eli…” Someone erased a woman from the story, but could not make everyone forget her.
en.Лист, пламя и луна соединяются в тонкую: The leaf, the flame and the moon join in a slender thread of light. The door no longer divides the worlds. Veres is first across the new bridge; the others follow. Going home no longer means saying goodbye. You have not become the keeper of someone else's rules. You have made your own.
en.Луна не создаёт свет, {name}. Она возвра: The moon doesn't create light, {name}. It reflects it. Sometimes that's all someone who is lost needs.
en.Луна — третий знак. Она не создаёт свет,: The moon is the third sign. It does not create light; it reflects it. Three signs: leaf, flame, moon.
en.Любовь к новому месту не стирает прежнюю: Loving a new place doesn't erase your love for the old one. But the people waiting for you should know you're alive. I'll keep your letter safe until the passage opens.
en.Лёгкое дыхание, акцент на говорящем и пл: Gentle breathing, emphasis on the speaker and smooth expression changes.
Maren, queen of this impossible garden. Here, flame preserves memories. Flame is the second sign on the key.

en.На ладони остаётся тёплый ключ с тремя п: A warm key with three empty sockets rests in your palm. Someone calls your name from behind the door: “{name}…”
en.На поверхности замёрзшего озера застыла: A bird hangs frozen above the icy lake. It is not dead: it simply cannot finish a single beat of its wings.
en.На полях созвездий: In the Margins of the Stars
en.На последней странице оказалась тонкая д: On the last page, you find a slender doorway. Beside it lies a scrap of paper, tucked between the pages so long ago that you cannot remember where it came from.
en.Наверху пустует комната. Свет там плохой: There's an empty room upstairs. The light isn't good for flowers, but it's lovely for drawing. I'd like a neighbour. Someone I don't have to pretend to be strong with.
en.Нажми на текст или пробел, чтобы увидеть: Tap the text or press Space to reveal the whole line.
en.Напиши домой. Не отчёт о подвиге — прост: Write home. Just a letter, not an account of heroic deeds. What you ate. Who made you laugh. What frightened you.
en.Нарисовать первый урок для будущей школы: Illustrate the future school's first lesson
en.Начинай с живого, продолжай тёплым, зако: Begin with what lives, continue with warmth, and end with reflected light. The star is decoration, not part of the lock.
en.Нивель оставляет на рисунке свободное не: Nivelle leaves open sky around the bird in your drawing.
en.Никто не пишет баллады о починенных пери: No one writes ballads about mended railings. But I know someone will get home safely. That's enough for me.
en.Новая история заменит автосохранение. Ру: Starting a new story will replace your autosave. Manual saves will remain. To return to this moment later, save it in a slot first.
en.Общий стол подземного сада: The shared table in the underground garden
en.Он удержал её между мирами. С тех пор вс: The key trapped her between worlds. Ever since, everything has been losing its names, its memories, its time. I didn't know how to fix it… so I called someone else.
en.Она захотела домой. А я попросила ключ о: She wanted to go home. I asked the key to keep the door open until she changed her mind. I said “until”. The key heard “forever”.
en.Она умеет чинить двери, но учится не уде: She knows how to mend doors. Now she is learning to let people leave.
en.Орин долго молчит. Затем снимает с часов: Orin is silent for a long time. Then she lifts the glass dome from the clock. “Perhaps I do, too.”
en.Осколок уже у тебя. Теперь ответь ему: ч: You have the shard. Now tell it: what helps living things grow?
en.Отдаёт людям их время, хотя своё долго т: She gives people back their time, though she spent so much of her own waiting.

en.Помнит песни пассажиров и мечтает однажд: She remembers her passengers' songs and dreams of playing one of her own.
en.Последние огни остались за спиной. Я шаг: The last lights faded behind me. I stepped beneath the trees and slowed down. It felt as though the forest was listening to me.
en.Посмотри на альбом. На рисунке зажёгся т: Look at your sketchbook. Your own windowsill is glowing in the drawing. You never lost the way; you were learning how to recognise it.

en.Сзади ещё слышен дождь, но впереди уже ш: You can still hear rain behind you. Ahead, unfamiliar trees are rustling. You take a step between the two sounds.
en.Сначала просыпается лист, потом отзывает: First the leaf awakens, then the flame answers. Last, the moon lights the way.
First the leaf awakens, then the flame answers. Last, the moon lights the way. That's the whole song. Write it down before you forget.
en.Строит обсерваторию, где каждый сможет н: She is building an observatory where anyone can name a star of their own.

en.Теперь ты знаешь, почему страницы пустею: Now you know why the pages are fading. The mechanism is holding someone's will captive and erasing everything that contradicts it. Even her friends' memories.
en.Тогда начни с вопроса, на который сама н: Then start with a question you don't know the answer to. We'll save the biggest page for that.
en.Ты берёшь альбом. Бумага тёплая, хотя ча: You pick up your sketchbook. The paper is warm, though the tea beside it has long gone cold. One window in the drawn castle lights up.
en.Ты выбираешь комнату над садом Марен. Пе: You choose the room above Maren's garden. The first harvest is small, but your flowers grace the shared table. You paint signs and teach the children to press flowers; Maren learns to leave her work until morning. Sometimes you argue over little things, then make up over tea. You stay for this closeness, and for a life you can help create. A letter bearing your new address goes home.
en.Ты держишь ключ слишком крепко. Ещё немн: You're holding that key too tightly. Any tighter and you'll start thinking it belongs to you.
en.Ты как раз вовремя. Хотя все мои карты у: You're just in time. Though every one of my star charts said otherwise. I'm Astrid.
You can keep the memory without holding her here.
en.Ты обводишь незавершённое имя в дневнике: You circle the unfinished name in your journal. The key chimes softly, as though it recognises the name too.
en.Ты опускаешься рядом с ней на влажную тр: You sit beside her on the damp grass. Veres gently rests her hand over yours.
en.Ты остаёшься в лесной долине. У тебя поя: You stay in the forest valley. There is a desk of your own in Veres's workshop. In the mornings, you map accessible paths together; in the evenings, she teaches you to listen to the forest. You do not always agree, but you have learned to ask each other. Your first map, bearing both your names, hangs on the door. A letter has gone home. A new life does not mean forgetting the old one.
en.Ты остаёшься у маяка Саэль. Внизу открыв: You stay at Sael's lighthouse. A small navigation school opens downstairs: your maps on the walls, lenses and pencils on the tables. You each have your own work and time to yourselves; you share the night watches. Two cups by the east-facing window become a familiar sight. You have chosen love, work and a home of your own, and sent a letter to those waiting in your old world.
en.Ты пишешь о хлебе Эш, чернилах на пальца: You write about Ash's bread, the ink on Veres's fingers, and Maren's tea. Your journey is filling with little things you want to tell someone about.
en.Ты складываешь страницу вчетверо. Чужая: You fold the page into quarters. This is no longer just someone else's mysterious story. There is a person at its heart, and someone here is waiting for her.
en.Ты соединила два мира. Но у этой истории: You have joined two worlds. But this story still has other paths to explore.
en.Ты тянешься к отражению нарисованной две: You reach for the reflection of the drawn doorway. Cold brass meets your fingers: a handle. The room dissolves into the scent of wet leaves, and a key falls into your palm.
en.Файл повреждён. Можно перезаписать ячейк: This save is damaged. You can overwrite the slot.
en.Хочет нарисовать карту, на которой найдё: She wants to draw a map with room for other people's memories.
en.Часы за её спиной стоят. На столе два пр: The clock behind her has stopped. There are two place settings on the table, but one lies beneath a thin layer of dust.
en.Часы с обеденным перерывом: A clock with a lunch break
en.Через неделю приходит открытка. «Спасибо: A week later, a postcard arrives. “Thank you for asking. Elian.” On the back is that same castle. Now you know the meeting was not a dream.
en.Что бы ты сейчас ни выбрала, это не обес: Whatever you choose now, it won't diminish what you shared with the people you met. Closeness isn't a lock on a door.
en.Я Верес. Каждый день этот лес теряет одн: I'm Veres. Every day, this forest loses a memory. Today it forgot how to unfurl its leaves.
en.Я боюсь, что если мне здесь хорошо, это: I'm afraid that being happy here means home wasn't enough.
I froze that moment to save her. Now I'm afraid to let her go.
en.Я ремонтировала эти часы двадцать лет. Е: I've spent twenty years repairing this clock. If I'd finished sooner, I'd have had to decide what to do with the rest of my life.

es.{companion} встречает тебя по ту сторону: {companion} te recibe al otro lado de la puerta. No como salvadora ni como invitada, sino como alguien para quien han guardado un lugar. Te espera una vida cotidiana, difícil y hermosa. Esta vez, tú has elegido con quién compartirla.
es.«Начать заново можно и с прошлым». Марен: "Puedes empezar de nuevo sin borrar tu pasado". Maren te entrega el fragmento. Aquí un error no cierra todas las puertas.

es.«Тогда начнём с правды: однажды я уже вы: "Entonces déjame comenzar con la verdad: una vez, tomé la decisión de otra persona por ella. No lo volveré a hacer". Adele mira hacia otro lado por primera vez.
es.«Ту, которая обещала вернуться». Ты расс: «A la que prometió volver». Le hablas a Orin del pájaro de Nivelle. Cuando te marchas, el segundero empieza a moverse.
es.«Увидим, что получится». У твоего горшка: "Veamos qué crece". Tu maceta encuentra un lugar al lado de la de ella.
es.«Что однажды некому будет греться рядом»: “Que un día no quedará nadie para calentarse”. Recuerdas su respuesta.
es.«Этого достаточно». Вы встречаете рассве: «Eso basta». Contempláis el amanecer sin hacer promesas para las que ninguna de las dos está preparada.
es.«Я — да. Дверь — пока нет». Голос звучит: "Yo puedo. La puerta no puede. Todavía no". La voz suena cansada, casi humana. Aparece una grieta en forma de media luna en el cristal.

es.Адель отодвигает инструменты. Маленькое: Adele hace a un lado sus herramientas. De alguna manera, ese pequeño espacio vacío parece el comienzo de un cambio.

Pero tú ya caminas bajo estrellas desconocidas, con la llave en la palma abierta. Esta vez, la historia no comienza porque alguien te haya llamado. Tú misma has dado el primer paso.

es.В дорожном альбоме появляется ещё одна с: Otra línea de Elian aparece en tu cuaderno de bocetos de viaje: "Gracias por darme un nuevo comienzo. Ahora cuida el tuyo".
es.В зеркальном гнезде появляется твоё отра: Tu reflejo aparece en la ranura de espejo. La puerta espera.

es.В памяти остаются общий чертёж, тёплая ч: Un dibujo hecho entre las dos, una taza caliente, un sitio junto a la mesa de trabajo: eso es lo que recuerdas. Si te quedas, también habrá cansancio, discusiones y días corrientes. Eso es lo que hace real un mundo.
es.В старом альбоме: «Если отражение задерж: En el viejo cuaderno de bocetos: "Si tu reflejo se queda atrás, no preguntes quién te llama. Pregúntale si te pueden dejar ir". En el margen se dibuja una media luna familiar.
es.В твоём будущем появляются ученики, свет: Te imaginas un futuro con estudiantes, el rayo del faro y dos tazas en el alféizar de la ventana. La última puerta sigue abierta.
